svg.title: BackOnTrack: forward and lateral lean against the rule thresholds, same session
svg.desc: The same 48,593-frame, 40.5-minute session, with the firmware's lean features recomputed from the logged quaternion against a neutral taken from the first 10 seconds. Upper panel: forward lean in degrees with the 10 degree Slouching and 25 degree Leaning Forward thresholds; it stays below the Slouching line for 100 percent of frames. Lower panel: lateral lean in degrees with the plus and minus 12 degree Leaning Left and Right thresholds; the wearer sits past the Leaning Left line for 19 percent of the session, one sustained stretch, marked in red.
svg.text: LATERAL LEAN FROM NEUTRAL, DEGREES · + RIGHT
minutes into the session · band = min–max per 7 s window · red band = frames past a threshold
